meta.title: Allegheny County Behavioral Health Provider Directory
meta.scope: Mental health and substance use services, crisis and access points, and the peer, family, housing and specialty services call-center staff refer to. Out-of-county programs are included only when the county directory lists them for Allegheny County residents (inAlleghenyCounty: false).

howToRead.services[].facilities: Facility ids where the service is offered. An empty list means the provider offers it but the site isn't confirmed: call the provider.
howToRead.ageGroups: children, adolescents, transition-age-youth, adults, older-adults. minAge/maxAge are set only when a source states them.
howToRead.flags: Anything a worker should double-check before referring.
howToRead.status: active, or verify (named by a source but missing details).

meta.warning: Compiled from public sources for a prototype. Confirm hours, eligibility and openings with the provider before referring. In an emergency call 911; for a mental health crisis, 988 or resolve at 1-888-796-8226.
gaps: Private group practices and individual therapists are not included.

Federally qualified health centers with integrated behavioral health (for example Squirrel Hill Health Center, Primary Care Health Services, East Liberty Family Health Care Center, Sto-Rox) are not yet included.
Office-based buprenorphine prescribers and most methadone clinics beyond Tadiso and UPMC NATP are not yet included.
Insurance accepted is only recorded where a source states it. Community Care's directory is the source of truth for HealthChoices.
Hours are only recorded where a source states them.
Some offices named by the county have no address in any source checked; they are marked status 'verify'.
'CHBH' in the request was read as Community Care Behavioral Health (CCBH), the county's HealthChoices plan; its online directory is dynamic and wasn't scraped.

changes.subject: Heritage Valley Kennedy
changes.text: Heritage Valley Kennedy (McKees Rocks) closed its ER, and its adult and geriatric inpatient behavioral health units closed ('temporarily'). The county's current list of emergency psychiatric exam sites no longer includes it.
Heritage Valley Health System, which runs Staunton Clinic, is now part of Allegheny Health Network.
AHN Allegheny Valley Hospital's inpatient psychiatric unit now serves only patients 60 and older; younger adults go to AHN Forbes or AHN Jefferson.
The county's current list of emergency psychiatric exam sites adds UPMC Presbyterian and UPMC Shadyside.
Pittsburgh Mercy runs a 24/7 walk-in crisis center at 264 South 9th Street, which isn't in the February 2025 county booklet.
Gateway's Fox Chapel outpatient office (in the county booklet) is not on Gateway's current locations page.
Familylinks affiliated with Life'sWork of Western PA.
Wesley Family Services affiliated with Transitional Services, Inc.
